Index a country's TB burden against its 2015 baseline

Source: R/tb_progress.R
tb_index.Rd

Rescales the chosen indicator so that each country's value in the baseline year equals 100. An index of 60 in 2023 therefore means the burden is 40% lower than in 2015. Countries whose baseline value is missing or zero get NA, because a percentage change from zero is undefined.

Usage

tb_index(
  data = tbprogress::tb_burden,
  indicator = c("incidence", "mortality"),
  baseline_year = 2015L,
  countries = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with the columns of tb_burden. Defaults to tb_burden.

indicator

Either "incidence" (incidence rate per 100,000) or "mortality" (number of TB deaths).

baseline_year

The year used as 100. Defaults to 2015, the baseline of the WHO End TB Strategy.

countries

Optional character vector of country names to keep. NULL (default) keeps all countries.

Value

A tibble with one row per country-year and columns country, iso3, who_region, year, value (the indicator), baseline_value, index (baseline = 100) and pct_change (percent change since the baseline; negative means the burden has fallen).

Examples

idx <- tb_index(indicator = "incidence", countries = c("Kenya", "India"))
subset(idx, year == 2023)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 8
#>   country iso3  who_region       year value baseline_value index pct_change
#>   <chr>   <chr> <chr>           <int> <dbl>          <dbl> <dbl>      <dbl>
#> 1 India   IND   South-East Asia  2023   195            237  82.3      -17.7
#> 2 Kenya   KEN   Africa           2023   223            380  58.7      -41.3
